Flow Out

Constant flow out of a compartment that does not go to another compartment. Flow In and Flow Out options can be pieced together to create a customized Flow Between. In the Figure below, we see a constant flow, F, carrying species, A_1, out of Compartment 1.

The mathematical derivation for this model output would be:

\[V_{1} \frac{dA_{1}}{dt} = - F * A_{1}\]
